description: Searches homes for sale or to let from participating UK estate agents with one plain-English query, e.g. '3 bed house in Folkestone under £300k' or 'flats to rent CT20'. Name a town, outcode or postcode. Returns up to 20 results, each with an id to pass to fetch. Made for apps that use standard search and fetch tools (ChatGPT deep research); search_listings takes the same filters separately.
